instruction: Add a function `top_words(text, n)` to text_stats.py. Use the existing `tokenize()` helper to get words, compare words case-insensitively using str.casefold() (so 'Straße' and 'STRASSE' are the same word), and return a list of (word, count) tuples for the `n` most frequent words, where `word` is the casefolded form. Order by count descending; words with equal counts must appear in the order they FIRST occurred in the text. If n <= 0 return []; if n exceeds the number of distinct words return all of them. Do not change `tokenize()` or `word_count()`. All tests in tests/test_text_stats.py must pass.
